# Hardship Discharge in Bankruptcy [2026]: 11 USC 1328(b) Three-Element Standard and Filing Process
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Hardship discharge under 11 U.S.C. 1328(b) lets Chapter 13 debtors exit early when circumstances change. Free 2026 guide.

## About
bankruptcyhardship.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
